title: Continuous microwave tunnel expansion of vermiculite: a comparative study with thermal/chemical methods for structure-intact performance enhancement

The pore walls of C-EVMT was thickened due to the use of H2O2, the M-EVMT exhibited an essentially uniform interlayer spacing and the layers of T-EVMT were widely separated, forming a porous structure with more complete interlayer detachment.
